image_description: A market scene featuring a large pile of Dungeness crabs on crushed ice in the foreground. A person wearing a red jacket is visible on the left, holding up a handwritten sign. Another sign stands upright on the right. The background shows a busy indoor market environment with other stalls and people.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Eyes are stalked and protrude from anterior carapace margin.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The crabs are viewed primarily from a dorsal/top-down angle or are piled such that the anterior margin and eye stalks are obscured by the carapace edge or other crabs. Specific eye structures are not clearly resolvable.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Carapace is smooth and convex displaying purplish-brown to reddish-brown coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The visible carapaces exhibit the characteristic reddish-brown hue and appear smooth and convex, consistent with the species description.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Ventral surface is cream to white.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The crabs are positioned dorsal-side up on the ice; the ventral surface (abdomen/underside) is hidden against the ice or beneath other crabs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Broad oval carapace of substantial edible-crab proportions.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The crabs display the distinct broad, oval shape typical of Dungeness crabs, distinguishing them from narrower spider crabs or blue crabs.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Carapace displays lighter mottled patterns over purplish-brown base.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Subtle lighter mottling and texture variations are visible on the brown carapaces, matching the natural appearance of the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Exoskeleton is hard and calcified with smooth glossy texture.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The light reflections on the shells indicate a hard, smooth, and slightly glossy surface typical of calcified exoskeletons.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Five pairs of walking legs extend laterally.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Multiple crabs show the correct arrangement of legs extending from the sides of the carapace. While not all 10 legs are visible on every individual due to piling, the general anatomy is correct.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: First pair modified into robust claws of unequal size with dark tips.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The prominent front claws (chelipeds) are visible on several crabs, appearing robust with darker coloration at the tips, consistent with the species.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Claws have smooth outer surface and serrated inner edges.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: While the outer smoothness is visible, the resolution and angle do not allow for verification of the fine serrations on the inner edges of the claws.

artifact_observations.location: Handwritten signs held by person and standing on right
artifact_observations.reasoning: The text on the signs is illegible and structurally nonsensical. The characters mimic handwriting but fail to form coherent words or letters, exhibiting typical AI-generated text artifacts (melting letters, inconsistent baseline).
The ice lacks distinct crystalline structure, appearing as a smeared, cloudy mass rather than individual shards. It blends softly into the crabs' legs in some areas.

artifact_observations.location: Pile of crabs in the center-right background
artifact_observations.reasoning: Some crabs in the deeper pile appear to merge into one another without clear boundaries, creating a 'mushy' effect where individual exoskeletons should be distinct rigid objects.
The hand gripping the sign appears distorted, with fingers blending into the paper and lacking clear joint definition. The grip geometry looks physically implausible.

selected_experts.reason: To confirm the specific species classification and rule out look-alike crustaceans.
To verify if individual crabs maintain distinct boundaries or if they suffer from fusion/melting artifacts in the dense pile.
To rigorously analyze the illegible text artifacts and confirm they are non-functional gibberish.
To assess the texture quality of the ice and detect any subtle background warping or coherence issues.

focus_areas: Text legibility and structure on signs
Boundary separation between individual crabs in the pile
Anatomical correctness of the human hand holding the sign
Texture realism of the crushed ice
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the text on the signs; it is a primary indicator of AI generation here. Also, scrutinize the contact points between the crab legs and the ice, as well as the overlapping crabs, for signs of soft-body fusion which contradicts the hard-shell nature of the subject.
